Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs, SOXL (-32.39%) and SPAL (-28.23%), are flashing "SELL" and are deep in the red. Remember, margin amplifies these drops. SMH is also down (-4.54%).

Watch: Keep a close eye on interest rate movements and any further signs of broad market weakness. Also, watch for continued strength in AI infrastructure plays.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing risk in your deeply negative leveraged positions while staying alert for opportunities in core AI infrastructure.
plays: Re-evaluate SOXL and SPAL stops. They are leveraged, deeply negative, and their current stops are above price, indicating a need to manage margin risk. Consider trimming or exiting.
